ocr.notes: First sentence garbled; rest mostly right.

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Gallagher denied he was beaten and wanted a rematch, while Allen said there would be no more fighting until the stakes were given up, since Gallagher's second had thrown up the sponge.

metadata.notes: Same page as 355: 'Daily Democrat', Thursday morning, August 19, 1869. Headline 'Allen and Gallagher. Gossip About the Late Fight.'

facts.fact: After the August 17 fight, Allen told the paper there would be no more fighting until the stakes were given up; he said the referee had not made a final decision and none was needed because Gallagher's second threw up the sponge
Allen said a scar under his left eye came from a club thrown into the ring during the Gallagher fight
Gallagher denied he was beaten and offered to add about $1,000 to the stakes and fight Allen again after Allen and McCoole settled their dispute
A fight between Allen and Mike McCoole was expected in November 1869

notes: Allen's statement is reported speech, not a direct quote.
